title: vocab/<name>.toml
description: Your closed set for every argument that names this vocabulary: word = meaning. Packages never ship or write one. Reference: docs/manual/reference/files.md.

propertyNames.description: The word the classifier chooses and the body receives unless a value is set. Trimmed; spaces allowed; none and unstated are reserved.

what.description: What the word means, in your words; other names for it help.

value.description: What the body receives instead of the word. Never shown to the classifier.
